snippet.title: NekoClaw: Waifu Catcher - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist NEKOCLAW: WaifuCatcher on Steam!
Come check it out all the cute waifus and the insane battles 💕🐾🐈‍⬛

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3646390/NEKOCLAW_Waifu_Catcher/

NekoClaw: Waifu Catcher is a Claw Machine roguelike strategy game where you catch orbs containing girls who auto-battle to the death. Go on adventures with your squad, collect unique figurines, unlock outfits, upgrade your favorites, and grab orbs faster to claim victory.







#indie #indiegame #steam #steamgame #unreal #unrealengine #unrealengine5 #waifu #waifus #clawmachine #anime #cat #cats #neko #nekoclaw
